### 🎴 FC_MAIN_02: Phylum Coelenterata
**Category:** `History & Fundamentals`

> **💡 Answer / Definition:** First animal phylum in evolution to exhibit true tissue-level grade of organization.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Phylum Coelenterata" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### 🎴 FC_MAIN_03: Simple Squamous Epithelium
**Category:** `Epithelial Tissue`

> **💡 Answer / Definition:** Flattened pavement endothelium lining blood vessels and alveolar air sacs.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Simple Squamous Epithelium" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### 🎴 FC_MAIN_04: Transitional Epithelium (Urothelium)
**Category:** `Epithelial Tissue`

> **💡 Answer / Definition:** Plastic distensible compound epithelium with umbrella cells lining urinary bladder.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Transitional Epithelium (Urothelium)" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>


---

### 🎴 FC_MAIN_05: Tight Junctions vs Gap Junctions
**Category:** `Epithelial Tissue`

> **💡 Answer / Definition:** Tight junctions seal fluid barriers; Gap junctions pass ions/signals between cells.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Tight Junctions vs Gap Junctions" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>


---

### 🎴 FC_MAIN_06: Fibroblasts & Mast Cells
**Category:** `Connective Tissue`

> **💡 Answer / Definition:** Fibroblasts synthesize matrix/collagen; Mast cells release histamine/heparin/serotonin.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Fibroblasts & Mast Cells" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>


---

### 🎴 FC_MAIN_07: White Fat vs Brown Fat
**Category:** `Connective Tissue`

> **💡 Answer / Definition:** White fat is monolocular energy storage; Brown fat is multilocular UCP-1 heat generator.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="White Fat vs Brown Fat" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>


---

### 🎴 FC_MAIN_08: Compact Bone Osteon
**Category:** `Connective Tissue`

> **💡 Answer / Definition:** Haversian canal surrounded by concentric lamellae, lacunae with osteocytes, and canaliculi.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Compact Bone Osteon" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>


---

### 🎴 FC_MAIN_09: Skeletal vs Smooth Muscle
**Category:** `Muscular Tissue`

> **💡 Answer / Definition:** Skeletal muscle is voluntary, striated, syncytial; Smooth muscle is involuntary, unstriated, fusiform.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Skeletal vs Smooth Muscle" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>


---

### 🎴 FC_MAIN_10: Cardiac Intercalated Discs
**Category:** `Muscular Tissue`

> **💡 Answer / Definition:** Junctional complexes with fascia adherens, desmosomes, and gap junctions for cardiac syncytium.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Cardiac Intercalated Discs" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>


---

### 🎴 FC_MAIN_11: Sarcomere Contraction
**Category:** `Muscular Tissue`

> **💡 Answer / Definition:** I-band and H-zone shorten, Z-lines approximate, while A-band length remains constant.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Sarcomere Contraction" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### 🎴 FC_MAIN_12: Nissl's Granules
**Category:** `Nervous Tissue`

> **💡 Answer / Definition:** Clumps of RER and free ribosomes synthesizing protein in cyton and dendrites; absent in axon.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Nissl's Granules" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>


---

### 🎴 FC_MAIN_13: Astrocytes & Blood-Brain Barrier
**Category:** `Nervous Tissue`

> **💡 Answer / Definition:** Star-shaped CNS glia forming perivascular end-feet surrounding brain capillaries.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Astrocytes & Blood-Brain Barrier" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>


---

### 🎴 FC_MAIN_14: Oligodendrocytes vs Schwann Cells
**Category:** `Nervous Tissue`

> **💡 Answer / Definition:** Oligodendrocytes form CNS myelin; Schwann cells form PNS myelin.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Oligodendrocytes vs Schwann Cells" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>


---

### 🎴 FC_MAIN_15: Saltatory Action Potential
**Category:** `Nervous Tissue`

> **💡 Answer / Definition:** Fast impulse conduction leaping from Node of Ranvier to Node of Ranvier in myelinated axons.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Saltatory Action Potential" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>
